title: Service usage report (fabric-service/0.1, DEC-0021, DEC-0027, DEC-0183)
description: What a service's model and paid-tool calls cost (money, and a subscription's estimate apart by route, DEC-0110), self-reported from its own usage receipts, in UTC days. An unknown cost is null, never 0.

budgets.description: Every spending limit the service applies, enforced or not (DEC-0027). Ids are unique (FAC-SEM-031).

limitChanges.description: DEC-0183 SL-4: the latest changes of the limits in budgets[], newest first, at most 64, so a host shows who changed what. Ids are unique (FAC-SEM-031).

months.description: DEC-0183 SL-6: money per UTC month for up to the last 12 months, oldest first, the current month last and partial, so a host can chart beyond the 31 days of days[] (FAC-SEM-031).

routeChoices.description: DEC-0186 RC-1 to RC-6: how the service pays for each model's work, a subscription or tokens, chosen on measured or estimated volume and price and reviewed by a date. One entry per piece of work and model; ids unique (FAC-SEM-184).

byGrant.description: DEC-0037: cost in the report's window attributed to each grant that authorized it (grant check receipts), a subscription's estimate included (DEC-0110).

receipts.description: The grant-check receipts this spend settles.

byProject.description: DEC-0065 (CON-OE-13): cost in the report's window by the project the service ran it for, a subscription's estimate included (DEC-0110), the service's own run attribution. It names no caller, session or person (DL-22). A call the service ran for no project is in no row. Sums and unknown costs: FAC-SEM-025.

taskRunId.description: The service's own id of the task run that spent: never a caller's identity (DL-22).

unmeasuredCalls.description: Every call whose token count the service did not measure in full, whatever it wrote to its caller (a null to a fabric-interop/0.2 reader, the measured lower bound to a 0.1 reader, a number beside partial: true, a call outside a job): while above 0 the token totals are a lower bound. Absent is 0 (DEC-0091).

route.description: DEC-0046, DEC-0061: the route the row's calls took — the operator's own login in its vendor's runner, an issued key, or the hosting platform's own metered models under the deployment's account (a listing in the cloud, the descriptor's runner.credentialKind platform-metered). Absent: not stated (a report written before DEC-0046).

limit.description: One spending limit and what was spent against it in its window (DEC-0027); editable and its bounds, DEC-0183.

kind.description: Open vocabulary. Known values: per_job, approval, daily, weekly, monthly, velocity, pool, emergency (weekly: DEC-0183). A reader shows an unknown kind generically and never rejects it.

period.description: The current calendar UTC day, ISO week (from Monday 00:00 UTC; DEC-0183 SL-1) or month.

editable.description: DEC-0183 SL-3: true when the service takes spend.limits.set for this limit; absent or false, a host offers no edit.

minUsd.description: DEC-0183 SL-3: the lowest limitUsd the service takes for this limit (only with editable: true).

maxUsd.description: DEC-0183 SL-3: the highest limitUsd the service takes for this limit (only with editable: true).

limitState.description: A limit's settable state before or after a change (DEC-0183).

limitChange.description: One change of a limit (DEC-0183 SL-4): when, by which kind of actor, through which door, before and after, and why. It names no person: byRef is opaque (DL-22).

by.description: Whose decision the change is (DEC-0183 SL-4): operator: the operator's, at the dashboard or relayed by an agent with _meta.decision (DEC-0121 AP-2); agent: an agent's own tightening, with no decision (SL-2); service: the service itself (a default applied, its configuration read at start).

byRef.description: An opaque reference of the actor (a grant, an agent id, an audit record), never a name, an email or a session id.

via.description: The door the change came through: the service's dashboard, its agent surface (spend.limits.set), or its own configuration.

before.description: null when the change created the limit.

month.description: Money in one UTC month (DEC-0183 SL-6): costUsd sums the rows not on a subscription (DEC-0110), null when none is priced.

routeChoice.description: One choice of a payment route (DEC-0186): the work and the model it covers, the route chosen, the volume and prices it was chosen on, why, and when it is reviewed. It names no person and no account (DL-22).

work.description: The piece of work this choice covers, in the service's own words (a pipeline, a job kind, all of the service's calls).

runner.description: The runner the work runs in (runners.schema.json). Required when chosen is subscription: a subscription runs only in its vendor's runner (DEC-0046 item 3).

chosen.description: The route chosen, by the names of a usage row's route (DEC-0046, DEC-0061).

reviewBy.description: The UTC date by which the choice is measured again; after decidedAt and at most 92 days after it (FAC-SEM-184). A past reviewBy is overdue: a host shows it, the report stays valid (RC-5).

reason.description: Why this route, in one or two sentences: the comparison, and anything the prices leave out (a quota the subscription shares with other work, a vendor's terms).

previous.description: The route chosen before this review, when it changed.

routeMeasure.description: The volume and prices a route choice rests on (DEC-0186 RC-2): over a window of UTC dates, measured from the service's own usage receipts or estimated before the first run, and both routes priced for one 30-day month of that volume. An unknown price is null, never 0 (DEC-0021).

basis.description: measured: counted from the service's own receipts in the window; estimate: before the work ran, from a trial or a plan (RC-1).

tokensUsdMonth.description: What one 30-day month of the window's volume costs on tokens (a key, or the platform's metered models) at the provider's or the price list's price; null when it could not be priced.

subscriptionUsdMonth.description: The monthly price of the subscription this work would use, or the share of it the service attributes to this work (said in reason); null when no subscription serves this model.

quotaFits.description: Whether the volume fits the subscription's usage quota beside the other work it serves: true, false, or null when not known. Absent: not stated.
